verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ تَرْنِيمَةً جَدِيدَةً، لِأَنَّهُ صَنَعَ عَجَائِبَ. خَلَّصَتْهُ يَمِينُهُ وَذِرَاعُ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm. O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.web: A Psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
verses.he: מִזְמֹ֡ור שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה ׀ שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־נִפְלָאֹ֣ות עָשָׂ֑ה הֹושִֽׁיעָה־לֹּ֥ו יְ֝מִינֹ֗ו וּזְרֹ֥ועַ קָדְשֹֽׁו׃

verses.ar: أَعْلَنَ ٱلرَّبُّ خَلَاصَهُ. لِعُيُونِ ٱلْأُمَمِ كَشَفَ بِرَّهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.web: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.he: הֹודִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָתֹ֑ו לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גֹּויִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: ذَكَرَ رَحْمَتَهُ وَأَمَانَتَهُ لِبَيْتِ إِسْرَائِيلَ. رَأَتْ كُلُّ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلَاصَ إِلَهِنَا.
verses.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.he: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדֹּ֨ו ׀ וֶֽאֱ‌ֽמוּנָתֹו֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: اِهْتِفِي لِلرَّبِّ يَا كُلَّ ٱلْأَرْضِ. ٱهْتِفُوا وَرَنِّمُوا وَغَنُّوا.
verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.web: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
verses.he: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ بِعُودٍ. بِعُودٍ وَصَوْتِ نَشِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.web: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.he: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנֹּ֑ור בְּ֝כִנֹּ֗ור וְקֹ֣ול זִמְרָֽה׃

verses.ar: بِٱلْأَبْوَاقِ وَصَوْتِ ٱلصُّورِ ٱهْتِفُوا قُدَّامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلرَّبِّ!
verses.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
verses.he: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרֹות וְקֹ֣ול שֹׁופָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י ׀ הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِيَعِجَّ ٱلْبَحْرُ وَمِلْؤُهُ، ٱلْمَسْكُونَةُ وَٱلسَّاكِنُونَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.he: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹאֹ֑ו תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْأَنْهَارُ لِتُصَفِّقْ بِٱلْأَيَادِي، ٱلْجِبَالُ لِتُرَنِّمْ مَعًا
verses.kjv: Let the floods clap [their] hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

verses.ar: أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، لِأَنَّهُ جَاءَ لِيَدِينَ ٱلْأَرْضَ. يَدِينُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلشُّعُوبَ بِٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.web: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.he: לִֽפְֽנֵי־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
